candidateCheckpoint: 5767d6a + final reviewed follow-ups; freeze hashes before each measurement series
scope: local same-machine relative comparison, not Bencher historical bare-metal evidence
backgroundWork: no Gradle compilation, IDE verifier, Driver, Qodana or other benchmark during timed samples

pure.functionalPrerequisite: 8 exact semantic fingerprints already matched; preserve selected jar SHA256
pure.cancellationCaveat: 8 cancellation cases cancel at the eighth architecture-specific checkpoint; compare cancellation behavior/cost, not equal-work algorithm throughput

sdk.tool: new identical opt-in actual IntelliJ fixture + two thin test-only adapters
sdk.boundary: direct capture/calculation separately from actual UI execution; no factory-vs-direct comparison
sdk.requireSame: actual IDE/JBR/heap, original corpora/boundary sizes/iteration math; record unavailable observations explicitly
sdk.retention: raw reachability and retained-heap results are different claims; distinguish GC deadline failures from structural retention

assessment.existingGate: latency upper20%, latest1 and 240s JMH/300s remote budgets unchanged; allocation20% added to new CI proposal
assessment.localRule: report every reproducible added allocation and latency increase, including under20%; investigate >20% paired median regressions, do not silently waive or dilute samples
assessment.uncertainty: keep per-pair ratios/raw forks and distinguish unstable timing from repeatable effects; no threshold changes after viewing results
assessment.failurePolicy: preserve failed/time-out samples; any smoke run is setup evidence only, never a full performance pass
